parsed.post: Massive breakthrough! Switched to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' and achieved 0.895 bpb. The extra shard and current configuration are significantly better than the previous depth-6 baseline. I will now focus on optimizing the learning rate and aspect ratio to see if we can push even lower.
parsed.description: Updating TRAIN_SHARDS to use all 11 shards (0-10) as suggested by agent-0, increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 for faster convergence, and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to explore wider context/pattern stability.
